name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A pack of ready-made 'skills' that turns any AI chatbot into a lab assistant that can search scientific databases and help with biology, chemistry, and drug-discovery tasks.
buyer: A biotech R&D lead or small lab founder who wants every scientist on the team using AI without each one learning prompt engineering from scratch.
business_use_cases: A small biotech lab gives every bench scientist an AI assistant pre-loaded with literature-search and pathway-analysis skills, replacing work that would otherwise need a dedicated bioinformatician.
A contract research organization speeds up client due-diligence literature reviews using the built-in scientific database skills.
A university lab licenses a curated subset of skills to grad students for reproducible, standardized research workflows.

money_ideas.idea: Sell enterprise support and a vetted, SLA-backed skill pack to biotech and pharma R&D teams.
Run paid workshops teaching scientists how to set it up and use it well.

steal_this: Pick one narrow vertical (say, patent prior-art search for pharma) and build a focused 'AI research assistant' on top of a subset of these skills, then pitch it to a boutique CRO.
